SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), max(join_date)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Gold') g FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY member_id),
asof AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Gold') g FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-08' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to GROUP BY member_id),
allm AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) n FROM dim_member),
latest AS (SELECT member_id, arg_max(tier, valid_from) t, count(*) c FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) cur_members, (SELECT max(n) FROM cur) max_cur, (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE g>0) cur_gold,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM asof) asof_members, (SELECT max(n) FROM asof) max_asof, (SELECT count(*) FROM asof WHERE g>0) asof_gold,
 (SELECT n FROM allm) all_members, (SELECT count(*) FROM latest WHERE t='Gold') latest_gold,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold') OR tier IS NULL) bad_tier,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) max_sale
